# FLX-7146: the calibration on the pinned state is stale

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

The Playback that forecasts.playback names declares drift with onBreach fail, and at least one statistic both states hold has moved past its threshold between the pinned state and the next one. Every verdict was written before the command exited, so the scores are on record whichever way it falls. The message names the statistic with the largest value. Calibrate on the next state, or declare onBreach warn to report without failing.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7146
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
